LanguageData.WetwareAndMechanitor.label: Wetware Mechanitor
LanguageData.WetwareAndMechanitor.description: You long ago understood that true power comes from the union of "wetware" and "hardware". You fled to this rimworld with three modified companions and a small squad of mechanoid servants.
LanguageData.WetwareAndMechanitor.scenario.summary: A mechanitor, three wetware xenohumans, and a small squad of servant mechanoids.
